version_notes: v1.1.1 (2026-10-18): gate fix - verify_no_fabrication.py: a comma right after a number ("In 2023, four new") was kept as part of the token, so a number or year already in the source was flagged as new ("2023,", "40,"). Trailing commas are now stripped; inner commas ("1,200") are kept and truly new numbers are still flagged. Found by the first live outcome-eval run of interview-prep (2026-10-18). v1.1.0 (2026-10-18) adds the fresh-context drafter-reviewer pass (step 3) via review_pass.py, bundled byte-identical from resume-tailor: the posting is fenced as untrusted, reviewer quotes count only where they really appear, and a posting requirement without a verified source fact becomes a user question. Advisory only; the verify_no_fabrication gate stays mandatory and runs last. v1.0.0 adds cover-letter as the 7th job-hunter family member, closing a real gap (the family had zero cover-letter capability). Drafts a posting-tailored cover letter from the user's confirmed profile/resume facts via draft_cover_letter.py, then routes the draft through the family's verify_no_fabrication gate (bundled byte-identical from resume-tailor) so no claim/number/employer is invented. Persuasive prose is allowed; new facts are not. Never auto-sends. Works standalone or routed by the orchestrator after resume-tailor.
